summary.text: Tackey Chan is a Democratic state representative from Quincy who has represented the 2nd Norfolk District since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he chairs the Joint Committee on Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure.

paragraphs.text: Chan graduated from Boston College High School, received a B.A. in politics from Brandeis University in 1995, and earned a J.D. from the New England School of Law.
Ballotpedia lists his professional experience as including service as a justice of the peace and says he holds a Massachusetts real estate license.
Chan has served in the Massachusetts House since 2011 and is a member of the Ward 5 Democratic City Committee in Quincy.
He is chair of the Joint Committee on Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure.
